verdict.rationale: Entra ID's own diagnostic settings can route activity logs to external endpoints for long-term retention, and Microsoft Graph exposes directory objects such as user lists for retrieval. That is product-native movement of some data out of the service, but nothing documents a whole-tenant export or a migration path for leaving. missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all directory and configuration data, an explicit open-format guarantee, offboarding or exit documentation, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Using Microsoft Entra diagnostic settings, you can route activity logs to several endpoints for long term retention and data insights.
